evidence: XRD (shown for 200 1C only in Fig. 1 ) of as-deposited films grown with N 2 plasma have discernible features corresponding to the (111) and (200) reflections of the cubic TaN cap layers and the (200) reflection of the silicon substrate, but do not appear to have diffraction features related to the gadolinium nitride. This is the case for all growth temperatures within the range investigated and is indicative of an amorphous microstructure.
